scripts.build: npm run build --prefix extension && npm run build --prefix helper
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix extension && npm run typecheck --prefix helper
scripts.test: node --test scripts/*.test.mjs && npm test --prefix extension && npm test --prefix helper
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.install:all: npm ci && npm ci --prefix extension && npm ci --prefix helper
scripts.release:check: release-kit check && npm ci --prefix extension && npm ci --prefix helper && npm run check
